caption: The drawing depicts a black silhouetted figure of a horse, shown in mid-leap with its front legs extended forward and its rear legs extended backward. The horse's mouth is open, and its mane is illustrated with jagged lines. The horse is mounted on a weather vane structure consisting of a vertical rod topped with a decorative, fleur-de-lis-like finial and a horizontal arrow with a pointed tip on the right side and fletching on the left side; the horse is positioned above and along the horizontal arrow. The background is a plain, unadorned light tan or beige color. The overall composition is centered, and the only visible text is a signature, "HELEN HOBART," located in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Weather Vane
